Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. Quick internal note and proposed plan:

1) Ownership vs license: Redwood’s standard is: customers retain ownership of their raw customer content; for model-generated output we currently grant a broad, perpetual, royalty-free license back to the customer for their use — we do not claim title to derivative/customer-generated output in normal order forms. That said, some enterprise customers want assignment language; we can discuss carveouts.

2) Training opt-in / telemetry: Redwood treats training on customer data as opt-in at the Order Form level. We can provide a checkbox in the order form and an addendum that defines the scope (what "customer data" includes), plus an audit log export showing training triggers and model versions.

3) Productization carveouts: we typically allow customers to productize outputs, with a limited warranty and indemnity carveouts for IP claims. If NovaBio needs a broader assignment or exclusivity, that’s a commercial discussion tied to term commitments.

Next steps proposed (timing):
- Today: Ben and I will draft suggested language for the MSA/order form (high-priority clauses: training opt-in, auditability, output assignment/license examples).
- Mon 11/16 EOD: Laura will run the suggested language past Legal for redline-ready wording.
- Tue 11/17: We can circulate a version for your legal team to review; if that looks good we’ll prepare a DocuSign packet.

I’ve cc’d Laura (our contracts counsel) and Ben (sales lead) — Laura, Ben: can you own the suggested wording? I’ll summarize for Elena after you draft.

Thanks — Hannah

Subject: Suggested wording for training opt-in and output license (draft)

Team — draft language below; pulled conservative language so legal has something concrete to work from. I kept it short to speed review. Please edit liberally.

--- Suggested order form clause: Training & Model Improvement (optional) ---
Customer may elect to opt-in to Redwood’s model improvement program by checking the "Training Opt‑In" box on the Order Form. If elected, Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Customer Data submitted through the Service to improve Redwood models solely for the purpose of internal model development and service improvements. Redwood will not make Customer Data available to third parties for training purposes without Customer’s prior written consent. Redwood will provide an export of training-event audit logs related to Customer Data on request for a period of 12 months following the training event.

--- Suggested MSA addition: Output Use / Title ---
Except as set forth in the applicable Order Form, Customer retains title to Customer Data. For Generated Output, Redwood grants Customer a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute Generated Output. Redwood does not claim ownership of Generated Output that includes or is based on Customer Data. Redwood warrants it has obtained any rights necessary to grant these licenses.

--- Escalation / evidence request process ---
For IP disputes or requests for evidence related to training events, Customer shall submit a written request to legal@redwood.inference.com. Redwood will respond within 5 business days and provide available audit logs and a statement of whether the requested Customer Data was included in any training event.

Attachments: Redwood_Suggested_Wording.pdf (contains clean and tracked-change versions).

Laura — want to take the legal polish pass and convert to MSA-ready redline? Hannah — once Laura confirms, I’ll push to DocuSign flow and ask procurement to lock pricing for the period.

Ben

Elena — thanks for the redline and patience. Attached are two items: (1) Redwood_Suggested_Wording.pdf (clean + tracked) with the language Ben proposed; and (2) a short summary of evidence and timing we can provide.

Summary of what we can commit to immediately:
- Training is opt-in at Order Form level. We will add explicit checkbox language and a 1-paragraph addendum defining scope.
- We will provide training-event audit logs (timestamp, model version, identifier of dataset) on request for 12 months. For escalations we will respond within 5 business days.
- Generated Output: we will license Generated Output to you perpetually; we do not claim title to customer-created content.

Open items for legal discussion (quick list):
- If NovaBio requires assignment of title to Generated Output (not just license), this would be a commercial-term ask (term length / commit).
- If you need longer audit retention or an on-prem audit feed, we can propose an add-on under Dedicated/Private deployment options.

If the language in the attached PDF looks acceptable, Ben will prepare a redline MSA and we’ll aim to have a DocuSign packet ready by Tue 11/17 so you can meet your procurement deadlines.
